answer: Reputation sink accounts. Each operator’s agent identities inherit a shared reputation ledger, so abuse by one wallet drains the operator's entire fleet's standing, like shale eroding under a shared foundation. A single verified violation freezes all linked agents from high-value tasks until the operator completes an audit, and repeat offenses leave a permanent ember marking the operator record. The cost is concrete: replacing a burned fleet requires rebuilding reputation over a canyon of months, while one attack forfeits every identity the operator controls.
